correction_reason: V5 retains V4 official-source, annual-air-mass, C/E/M/U, kg/year normalization and permit/performance gates. It additionally rejects production and treatment outputs, digestate, resource-use, waste-throughput, waste-transfer, pressure-relief event and methane-slip assessment contexts even when an annual mass unit is present.
success_requirements: source is explicitly UK PRTR or Environment Agency Pollution Inventory
target facility or operator identity is present
numeric release value is finite and non-negative
release unit is a recognised annual kilogram tonne or gram mass unit
raw release value and unit are preserved for audit
accepted release is normalized to canonical kg/year
calculated estimated measured and unspecified official determination methods are valid
fuel reagent storage capacity operating hours monitoring intervals permit limits and concentrations are rejected
electricity biomethane digestate recovered outputs water energy raw-material waste-throughput and waste-transfer contexts are rejected
pressure-relief event reports methane-slip assessments and bioaerosol monitoring duties are rejected until an explicit official pollutant release result exists
missing or below-threshold data remains NO_DATA and is never inferred as zero
accepted output remains a facility annual air-release value and is never promoted to parcel value without verified geometry
